name: Whalesong Blast
body:
You can weaponize your powerful vocalizations against your opponents.

Prerequisites: whalefolk, echolocation species trait.

Benefit: Once per hour, you can emit a 15-foot cone of sonic energy as a standard action. Each creature in the area of effect takes 2d4 damage. A successful Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 +1/2 your character level + your Constitution modifier) halves the damage, but a creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is also staggered for 1 round. The damage increases by 1d4 at 6th level and every 5 levels thereafter, to a maximum of 5d4 damage at 16th level.

Awesome Ancestries: Fantasy Animal Humanoids, Vol. 3 - Born to Be Wild. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
